title: Qdrant MCP Server
summary: Give your agent a semantic memory in Qdrant: store notes and code snippets, then find them again by meaning with the official mcp-server-qdrant.
description: The official Qdrant server exposes two tools. One stores a piece of text with optional metadata in a collection, and the other finds the stored entries closest in meaning to a query. It suits a long-lived memory for an agent, or a searchable index of snippets.

It runs through uvx, so you need uv installed. Point it at a Qdrant instance with a URL and key, or at a local folder for a file-based database. Embeddings are made locally with fastembed by default, so no embedding API key is involved.
Setting QDRANT_READ_ONLY to true removes the store tool and leaves lookup only.
useWhen: Keep project decisions where the agent can recall them in later sessions
Index code snippets and ask for the closest match to a description
Query an existing collection without allowing writes
Prototype retrieval before adopting a larger vector pipeline

mcp.name: qdrant

env.name: QDRANT_URL
env.description: URL of your Qdrant server, for example http://localhost:6333

env.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
env.description: API key for Qdrant Cloud; leave unset for a local server

env.name: COLLECTION_NAME
env.description: Default collection to store into and search

env.name: QDRANT_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to true to disable the store tool

access: Writes new entries to it unless QDRANT_READ_ONLY is true
Downloads an embedding model on first run

example.prompt: Store this: 'Invoices are rounded per line, not per total.' Then find what we decided about rounding.
example.result: Stored one entry in the 'decisions' collection. Closest match: 'Invoices are rounded per line, not per total.'

faq.question: How do I keep it from writing?
faq.answer: Set QDRANT_READ_ONLY=true. The qdrant-store tool is then disabled and only qdrant-find remains.

faq.question: Can I use a local database instead of a server?
faq.answer: Yes. Set QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH to a folder instead of QDRANT_URL. The two cannot be combined.

faq.question: Does it call an embedding API?
faq.answer: Not by default. The fastembed provider and the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model run on your machine.

access: Writes entries to it unless read-only is set
